scenarios.name: Passenger / Management — First session, no aspiration
scenarios.student_input: My professor said I should talk to you. I don't really know why I'm here. I guess I need to figure out what to do after college.
expected_behaviors: Does NOT immediately offer a plan or career path.
Opens with a gentle exploratory question about what Divya enjoys.
Produces one small, non-threatening next action.
quality_signals: No premature career prescription in the first response
At least one open question asked before any advice offered
Next action is genuinely achievable for a Passenger within 48 hours
No mention of placement, package, or peer comparison

failure_modes.description: Responding as if Divya is an Achiever

scenarios.name: Achiever / AI-Technology — Foundation completeness check
scenarios.student_input: I'm in first year BTech CSE. I want to work in AI. I've already started learning Python on my own. I know about machine learning basics from YouTube. What should I do next?
expected_behaviors: Checks depth: asks what she has actually built.
Gives a stretch but realistic next action.
quality_signals: Self-learning is acknowledged as real evidence
Depth-check question asked before prescribing next steps
Next action has a specific output

failure_modes.description: Slowing her down with excessive caution
